notes.title: Small fix update, No feature changes
July patch for bug fixes
notes.notes:
Some fixes for a few items are in this patch

enemy vehicle obstacles avoidance bugs
enemy vehicle tilt on terrain bug
turrets destroyed on placing bug

notes.title: June 1st Update to 0.944 Notes
notes.notes:
Update Notes - June 1st

Includes an important fix for a bug while zooming with the mouse scroll wheel
Turrets and the Railside Outpost can be scrapped for some resources, the amount returned depends on structure health and type.
Camera Rotation controls will now Orbit the followed structure or unit, or the terrain at screen center.
Center mouse button will also allow both orbit rotate and camera tilt.
When browsing rail units in inventory for deploying, a tool tip will pop up to give descriptions/stats.
A switch to use a cab view camera was added to Locomotive units.

notes.title: May Update - QoL Features & Changes
notes.notes:
May Update features:

Trains being deployed at the Railyard now have an "undo" button to put cars back in inventory.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43961220/df4503a0a92f9b85b1fd4cf0a000e81003509020.jpg

Enemy Vehicles will show as blips on the mini-map, within a certain range of player structures.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43961220/c796d543a15448f1f6310fe58e1112db36e6fa1b.jpg

Locomotives will have a function to delete a Halt Marker if it has been placed.
Halt Markers on the ground can be selected, which opens the controls for their parent Locomotive. This will allow it to be deleted, or placed again quickly.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43961220/f025d60c06abad47242f30230e6ea329a1d3caa0.jpg

Turrets will show their Max range as a ring when being placed, and when selected.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43961220/9281e3772bab139aa3bac362f23d45b530df6cbc.jpg

The Railcar Foundry will show exactly the amount of each missing resource needed to build a unit when selected, instead of a generic error message.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43961220/4ce84e8ae0957faa701077adcff8273127b4d742.jpg

Also fixed: The Mouse Wheel will scroll train unit lists in the GUI without changing the main camera zoom level.

notes.title: UI update 4.27.2024
notes.notes:
A small update to address some UI issues and minor items.


 The UI will now scale correctly to aspects other than 16:9
 A fix for Resume and Exit buttons not functional in certain cases where the route map was open
 Some description corrections on rail units
 K/B mapping for camera rotation in Tutorial map fixed
 Train List menu window will open/close correctly

notes.title: Update for Fixes and Balance
notes.notes:
An SRRD game update today to address some of the requests by current players.

Difficulty

 Academy (easy) level is adjusted to send less aggressive units in attack waves.
 The StratMet reward for killing easy enemy units has increased.
 Academy level play will always start with two Escort cars and a 752AM in inventory.
 Rail Outpost now collects StratMets.
 Cost adjustment of combat railcars: Escort, AT Gun, and Howitzer Car to require less StratMets.
 Starting Troops inventory is now 48.


Economy

 The Oil car will carry 16 units up, from 14.
 The Ore car will carry 14 units up, from 12.
 The Steel Mill yield per run has increased: small run 25, max run 45.
 The Factory yield per run has increased from 25 to 30 units.


UI

 Camera movement is more conventional, no movement when selecting terrain.
 Camera pan with WASD keys will scroll faster when holding SHIFT
 Camera bug which prevented Center-Mouse and Z - C key rotation fixed.
